title: 2023 Marco Leal interview inconsistency and ICU admission to James

tellings.quote: Well, they're right because I couldn't tell everything even in 2023

plain: A surgeon from Varginha, Brazil, named Italo Venturelli, speaking on a podcast about his hospital having operated on an alien, says differences in his 2023 interview with a man named Marco Leal came from not being able to tell everything back then. He says he later told a man named James Fox about an admission to the hospital's intensive care unit. He offers this to explain why his accounts have shifted over time.
